_meta.description: SMART-LM Rules based on Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
_meta.source_note: For official rules, refer to: Legal Metrology Act 2009, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, and amendments.

rules.requirement: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) must be declared on every package inclusive of all taxes.
MRP must be formatted properly with 'inclusive of all taxes'.
Net quantity must be declared in standard units.
rules.evidence_required: Value with unit (g, kg, ml, L, U)

rules.requirement: Name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer must be declared.
rules.evidence_required: Text containing manufacturer name and address

rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture or packing must be declared.
rules.evidence_required: Date format like DD/MM/YYYY or MM/YYYY

rules.requirement: Consumer care details (address/phone/email) must be declared.
rules.evidence_required: Phone number or email address with consumer care text

rules.requirement: Country of origin must be declared for imported commodities.
Best before / expiry date must be declared for perishable commodities.
rules.evidence_required: Date format associated with Best Before / Expiry

rules.requirement: Unit sale price must be declared where applicable.
rules.evidence_required: Price per unit (e.g. Rs./kg or Rs./L)

rules.requirement: Name or generic name of the commodity must be declared.
